Damon Lee: Quick question — during the last canary deploy I noticed a build token printed to worker stdout. snippet below. who owns rotating leaked CI/build tokens and do we have a quick runbook? cc @sec-bot :rotating_light:

Pranav Singh: oof. can you paste the exact line and which service?

Damon Lee: pasted from pod logs:```
2026-11-03T14:02:11Z INFO starting worker-queue
ENV API_BUILD_TOKEN=sk.build.prod.0xabcDEF123
2026-11-03T14:02:11Z INFO connecting to redis...
```
looks like our entrypoint script was echoing envs on startup.

Maria Chen: that shouldn't happen. CI injects the token at runtime so printing it is a bug in the image. happy to approve rotation once we confirm scope. who merged the worker entrypoint last?

Sylvia Ortiz: i can open a PR to remove the echo and add a scrubber to entrypoint. also: do we have short-lived KMS-wrapped tokens for CI? we should avoid raw tokens as envs where possible. @sec-bot any guidance on short-lived grant flow? :eyes:

sec-bot: SEC-BOT: Logged incident placeholder sec-2026-11-03-01. Refer to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ci-token-rotation and policy: https://redwood.internal/security/secret-handling

Pranav Singh: rotation playbook is `emergency-rotate-vault-token` (internal). tl;dr: revoke token -> generate new in Vault -> update pipeline secret ref -> deploy. If token had wide perms, escalate to incident response. Also recommend switching to KMS envelope / ephemeral STS creds for external builders.

Damon Lee: thanks. i will: 1) open PR to remove echo and add log scrub 2) check whether the token is still active and add exact id to incident sec-2026-11-03-01 3) request rotation. who should approve the revoke?

Maria Chen: i can approve and trigger rotation. if the token scope is limited to build artifacts, we can CRT rotate now and patch pipeline. if it's broader (prod write) -> full IR. please add token id and service name to the incident.

Damon Lee: added token id to the incident and linked PR: https://git.redwood/infrateam/worker-image/pull/224 (fixes echo + adds scrub). planning to rotate within the hour.

Sylvia Ortiz: also putting a follow-up: add a CI lint that fails builds if `echo \$` or raw `API_` env names are printed in Dockerfile/entrypoint. i'll draft the lint rule and add to devex backlog.

sec-bot: SEC-BOT: Reminder — importing keys into HSM requires security review and exec approval per policy. If rotation involves HSM-wrapped material, request the HSM-import ticket before action. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/hsm-policy

Pranav Singh: noted. if rotation touches HSM or vendor-managed grants we'll follow the HSM ticket flow. otherwise standard vault rotate + pipeline update.

Damon Lee: great, thanks everyone. i'll proceed with PR + rotation and post updates in the incident thread. :thumbsup:
